summary: GeneralPurposeEstimate::new rounds up by adding before dividing, causing checked_add to panic near usize::MAX despite the resulting estimates fitting in usize. The chunk calculation overflows first for encoded_len > usize::MAX - 7. The fix divides first and adds a remainder indicator, avoiding overflow in both estimates. The regression test added by this commit checks lengths near zero and usize::MAX against u128 calculations. This is a proposed verbatim reversal; no tests were executed.
expected_failure: Overflow when calculating number of chunks in input
